java.awt.image.BufferedImage img = new java.awt.image.BufferedImage(120, 60, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);

net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.Pipeline pipeline = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.Pipeline(
    new net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.Rotation(90)
);

java.awt.image.BufferedImage result = pipeline.apply(img);

assert result != null : "Resulting image should not be null";
assert result.getWidth() == 60 : "Expected width 60 after 90-degree rotation, got " + result.getWidth();
assert result.getHeight() == 120 : "Expected height 120 after 90-degree rotation, got " + result.getHeight();

System.out.println("__CHECK__ Pipeline " + result.getWidth() + "x" + result.getHeight());
